description: Boot an app class headless like run_app, then DRIVE it: a short script of actions — click a control (by its builder `id`, a CSS `selector` or its exact visible `text`), fill an input (`value`; the field is committed with Tab so the change event and its roundtrip fire), press a key, wait — performed in order against the running app, then the roundtrips settle and the result is photographed. This is the only tool that reaches the EVENT branch of `main( )` without a system: what a button does, what an input changes, whether a popup opens. Returns run_app's report plus one entry per action (performed, or why not — the first failing action stops the script, `notPerformed` counts the steps after it, and the picture is still taken) and the screenshot as an image. Needs a build_backend first; run_app boots and looks, this one boots, acts and looks.

action_timeout_ms.description: per-action timeout in ms (default 10000, between 500 and 120000)

actions.description: the script, at most 30 steps: { action: click | fill | press | wait, id? | selector? | text?, value? (fill), key? (press, e.g. Enter), ms? (wait, <= 10000), commit? (fill: false leaves the field focused) }

commit.description: fill: press Tab afterwards so the change event fires (default true)

id.description: the control id the builder wrote (`a( n = `id` v = `save` )`) — matched as is or as the UI5 view-prefixed `--save`

key.description: press: a Playwright key name (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, ...)

ms.description: wait: milliseconds (default 500, max 10000); with a locator instead: wait until it is visible

selector.description: a CSS selector, when there is no id

text.description: the exact visible text, e.g. a button label

value.description: fill: the text to enter ("" clears)

class_name.description: the app class to start, e.g. zcl_my_app

timeout_ms.description: boot timeout in ms (default 60000, between 5000 and 600000)

name: interact_app
